title_en: Constrained Variational Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Spaces
title_zh: 混合动作空间的约束变分策略优化
summary_en: The paper introduces Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending the constrained variational policy optimization framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, the constrained E-step has zero duality gap and yields a closed-form joint target distribution via exponential reward-cost reweighting when the dual optimum is at positive temperature. Using exact hybrid KL decomposition, a factorized M-step fits both discrete and conditional-continuous policy components under separate trust regions. Theoretical results include fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds for exact updates, and existence of a dual minimizer for approximate updates. Ablations show cost-aware reweighting is crucial for constraint control.
summary_zh: 本文提出了混合约束变分策略优化（H-CVPO），将约束变分策略优化框架扩展到混合动作空间。在有界性和严格可行性下，约束E步具有零对偶间隙，并且当对偶最优在正温度下达到时，通过指数奖励-成本重加权得到混合动作上的闭式联合目标分布。利用精确的混合KL分解，因子化M步在分离的离散和条件连续信任区域下拟合两个策略组件。对于精确更新，证明了固定参考代理改进和条件奖励-成本界；对于近似更新，建立了对偶最小化子的存在性。消融实验表明成本感知重加权对约束控制至关重要。
content_en: Constrained reinforcement learning in hybrid action spaces must coordinate discrete modes and mode-conditioned continuous controls under long-horizon cost constraints. Existing constrained hybrid-action methods typically optimize factorized policies directly in parameter space, whereas Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (CVPO) separates nonparametric improvement from parametric projection in its original continuous-action formulation. We introduce Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending this variational framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, its constrained E-step has zero duality gap and, when the dual optimum is attained at positive temperature, yields a closed-form joint target distribution over hybrid actions through exponential reward-cost reweighting. Using the exact hybrid KL decomposition, we formulate a factorized M-step that fits both policy components to this target under separate discrete and conditional-continuous trust regions. For exact E/M updates, we prove fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds with a sufficient feasibility-margin condition. For approximate updates, we establish the existence of a dual minimizer under continuity on a compact domain and use residual-based admissibility to determine whether to project the target. Ablations identify cost-aware reweighting as an important contributor to constraint control. Extensive experiments in simul
